pageTitle: Sin: The Kind that Doesn't Need to be Dealt With
name: Sin: The Kind that Doesn't Need to be Dealt With

descriptions.normal: There is something indubitably "sinful" about this dish from a health standpoint. As the leader of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, she will not lightly hand the task of dealing with sin to others — this is a matter of professionalism and personal ethics, after all. Sometimes, though, sharing such a solemn duty with one she trusts deeply is an... acceptable way of relieving stress.

effectTexts.normal: Increases all party members' Healing Bonus by 25% for 300s.
